Exercise: London Bridges

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- horizontal_pulling

Primary Muscles:

- lats

Secondary Muscles:

- biceps
- forearms
- middle back

Equipment:

- other

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:
None

Contraindications:

- condition: shoulder injury, description: May exacerbate shoulder issues due to the overhead position.
- condition: back pain, description: Can increase strain on the lower back, especially if not performed with proper form.

Exercise Variations:

- name: Single-Arm London Bridges, force: pull, level: advanced, mechanic: compound, primaryMuscles: ['lats'], secondaryMuscles: ['biceps', 'forearms', 'middle back']

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Pull-Up, equipment: bar
- exercise_name: Lat Pulldown, equipment: cable machine

Instructions:

- Attach a climbing rope to a high beam or cross member. Below it, ensure that the smith machine bar is locked in place with the safeties and cannot move. Alternatively, a secure box could also be utilized.
- Stand on the bar, using the rope to balance yourself. This will be your starting position.
- Keeping your body straight, lean back and lower your body by slowly going hand over hand with the rope. Continue until you are perpendicular to the ground.
- Keeping your body straight, reverse the motion, going hand over hand back to the starting position.
